verification.validation: Patch checks: AppShell unit tests (tab page phoneTitle keeps the phone title bar; a fill page ending with an AppActionBar or a data-ui-page-bar element drops the end space; not-last, hidden and scrolling cases keep it), shell test suite, typecheck, documentation and version checks, SDK and App builds, npm pack for both packages, and repository and tarball internal-content scans. No full gate, publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: AppShellPage.phoneTitle: true keeps a tab page's title bar on a phone; omitted, a tab page still has no title row.
A fill page whose last element is a docked bar (a UI footer bar such as AppActionBar, or an element marked data-ui-page-bar) has no end space under it; a scrolling page keeps it.
Align SDK and App adapter versions and reuse the immutable executor release and its six digests.
